fit.reasoning: The underlying bug was resolved in PR #9041 which merged on 2026-09-30, roughly two weeks before this issue was filed as a duplicate. Taking this issue would mean re-implementing work that already exists. The DSPy codebase is a strong skill match (Python, agent frameworks), but there is nothing left to contribute here.

sources_say.claim: PR #9041 'Fix: respect backoff_factor in all provider retry paths' was merged on 2026-09-30.
Issue comment by maintainer @okhat on 2026-10-03: 'This looks like a duplicate of #9041 — closing once CI passes.'
The issue is still marked 'Open' on GitHub as of the investigation date.
Last commit to dspy/predict/retry.py was 6 days ago, touching the exact lines in scope.

interpretation: The issue is open in state only — the fix has merged. GitHub does not auto-close issues when a PR merges unless the PR description contains a closing keyword.
The maintainer comment strongly implies intent to close, but the issue was not closed before this investigation ran.
Even if a second fix were possible, a duplicate contribution would be unlikely to be reviewed positively.
prerequisites: Familiarity with DSPy's LM abstraction layer (dspy/predict/)
Understanding of HTTP retry semantics (backoff, jitter)

blockers.text: The bug is already fixed in merged PR #9041. There is no remaining work for this issue.
The issue may be officially closed by the time you read it.
